name: AgnesCode Build Challenge
description: Solo, one-week online hackathon building anything using AgnesCode — Agnes AI's agentic coding tool similar to Claude Code or Codex. name: Orion Builder Hackathon
description: Three-week hackathon to build and ship any kind of AI agent — trading, social media, research, content, community tools, or anything new. Seven winners share the prize pool. Every entry receives an AI vetting score at submission plus community upvotes from registered builders. Judged on real work and working demos.

name: The Sandbox Beta Creators Game Jam
description: Build a game in The Sandbox Studio around the theme "Overgrown" — transformation, growth, decay, or wildlife. Lead judge is Larry @majornelson, the iconic voice of Xbox. Six special mention prizes beyond the top 3, including Best Movement, Most Atmospheric, Hardest to Put Down, and Most Ambitious. Must use The Sandbox Studio editor and submit before the deadline.

name: WeAreDevelopers Hackathon
description: Turn an idea into a working AI project. The WeAreDevelopers Hackathon brings developers together to build with AI at WeAreDevelopers World Congress North America in San José. The congress gathers over 10,000 builders, more than 500 speakers and over 20 stages, with a program built around how teams design, ship, run, secure and test software in the AI era.](http://lablab.ai/ai-hackathons/wearedevelopers-hackathon)

name: Kane CLI Online Hackathon

name: STRK20 Private Sprint
description: Ship a real privacy app on Starknet mainnet using STRK20, the shielded token protocol. Enter with a single pull request adding your repo, then build in public with three real mainnet transactions live before judging. Judged on integration depth, working product, innovation, and docs.

name: AI Gateway Hackathon
description: Build the best AI agent using any model, framework, or use case, routed through Vercel AI Gateway. Open source only, submit by replying to the announcement thread on X with your repo and a demo. Winners get contacted in October and announced at Vercel Ship AI.

name: Sibyl Labs Hackathon
description: Build an AI agent with persistent memory on Sibyl Memory, the dynamic data layer built for long-term recall. Stack in Base and Virtuals Protocol to boost your Builder Score, judged on a pass/fail memory gate plus a 100-point rubric. Register your team by Aug 31, then build Sep 1 to 10.
prize_note: $10,000 USDC across top 5 (1st: $4,000 + Network School residency)

name: Midnight: Build Privacy-First Apps — Wave 1

name: FUTURE IN MOTION — Global AI Video Hackathon
description: Create AI-generated short films using Alibaba's WAN 3.0 and other video models on the MotionMux platform. Choose from three tracks: Narrative Short for storytelling, Concept & VFX for pure visual experimentation, or UGC Open Creation for casual prompted films shared on social. Films run 15 seconds to 3 minutes, judged on theme fit, artistic expression, technical innovation, and completeness.
prize_note: $9,900+ across 3 tracks plus popularity and special nomination prizes (listed as $10,300 total)

name: Midnight Hackathon
description: Build privacy-first applications on Midnight across four tracks: AI apps where models act on private data under provable rules, mobile apps that keep sensitive data on-device, adding a privacy layer to an existing app, or cross-chain dApps using Midnight as the shared privacy engine. No blockchain experience required, half of past winners were new to the ecosystem.
prize_note: $125 digital gift card per winning team member

name: AI Builders Challenge with IBM Bob — August Challenge
description: Student-only monthly hackathon: build AI solutions with IBM Bob around the August theme, Advance Space Exploration with AI. Teams whose project does not fit the theme can submit to the Wildcard Challenge instead, same deadline and prizes. Open to students 18+ at colleges, universities, or technical schools, solo or in teams of up to five.
prize_note: $2,250 / $1,250 / $750 / $750 monthly (plus $5,000 grand prize across both months)

name: Frontier Engineering Challenge 2026
description: Solve a real-world software engineering problem using coding agents over a three-day sprint. The problem is revealed at kickoff, and every entry needs both a baseline and an advanced solution showing meaningful improvement. Individual only, one submission per person. Note: micro1 owns submitted work and may use it for AI model training.
prize_note: $10,000 cash across 3 selective awards, plus up to 50 paid opportunities at micro1

name: RYO-CHAN Hackathon
description: Build the intelligence layer for RYO-CHAN, a no-code AI trading platform. Three tracks: autonomous agents that reason over market data, dashboards that surface what changed and why, or new research tools filling gaps in RYO-CHAN's toolset. Mix tracks if it strengthens your build. Grand prize winner gets an all-expenses trip to RYO-CHAN's Tokyo HQ.
prize_note: $15,000 total across 3 tracks plus cross-track awards

name: Somnia × DreamDEX Event Contracts Hackathon
description: Build prediction market experiences on DreamDEX Event Contracts, from consumer trading apps and AI-powered trading agents to analytics tools and social prediction products. Submit a working prototype on testnet with meaningful use of DreamDEX APIs or SDKs. Production-ready applications are favored over simple proofs of concept.

name: Decentraland Friendzone Mobile Buildathon
description: Build a mobile-first social experience in a Decentraland World: a hangout, multiplayer activity, or cooperative or competitive game designed for touch controls and small screens. Must be open source, publicly accessible in-World throughout judging, and work as a persistent experience without a host or scheduled event.

name: Runpod Online Hackathon
description: Build, deploy, and scale AI applications on Runpod's GPU cloud infrastructure over six days. Build an inference API, AI agent, generative media workflow, fine-tuning pipeline, or new developer tool. Covers serverless inference, model training and deployment, and production considerations like performance and cost.
prize_note: Over $10,000 in cash and platform credits, plus bonus category prizes

name: Voice AI Hackathon
description: Build real-time conversational voice experiences using Agora Conversation AI, from voice assistants to healthcare and productivity tools. Open to developers, students, and startups, solo or in teams of up to 4. Agora Conversation AI must be a core part of the solution, and projects must be built during the hackathon period.

name: ETHOnline 2026 — 1inch Track
description: Build a custom Aqua app implementing a sophisticated DeFi position on 1inch's SwapVM stack, with a general track and a separate Continuity track for teams extending existing work. Projects using SwapVM opcodes score higher, and final positions must be demoed through tests or a UI with onchain execution shown.

name: ETHOnline 2026 — Hedera Track
description: Build on Hedera across four tracks: AI agentic payments with x402, open source contributions to the Hedera Harness, real-world asset tokenization with the Asset Tokenization Studio, or bring an existing Hedera project forward with substantive new work. Each track needs a public GitHub repo and a demo video under 5 minutes.

name: ETHOnline 2026 — World Track
description: Build with World's identity stack for verified humans and AI-assisted interactions. Extend an existing project with AgentKit to distinguish real human-backed agents from bots, open only to Continuity Track participants, or build a Selfie Check flow for risk, eligibility, or abuse prevention. Both tracks require a working app tested in the World ID Sandbox plus a written feedback document on the developer experience.

name: ETHOnline 2026 — Uniswap Foundation Track
description: Build on or integrate any part of the Uniswap stack, including the API, AMM v2/v3/v4, CCA, new v4 hooks, or tooling for the wider ecosystem, with a general track and a separate Continuity track for teams extending existing work. Requires a public repo, a FEEDBACK.md file, and a completed Uniswap Developer Feedback Form submission.

name: Make Waiting for AI Fun
description: Details limited — description of what to build was not available at time of listing. Related to Commonsmade's VibeFi. Includes a "Vault" prize structure paying out $20,000 plus 80% of all revenue generated by the winning entry, in addition to standard placed prizes.
prize_note: $60,000 total — $20,000 / $8,000 / $4,000 for 1st-3rd, $500 each for 4th-19th, plus a separate Vault prize of $20,000 + 80% of revenue generated

name: KeeperHub — The Agent Economy Hackathon
description: Build the best integration of KeeperHub, a deterministic execution layer for onchain agents, into a live project with real users. A separate bounty rewards shipping an open source feature to the KeeperHub repo itself, which stacks with the main track. Submissions need a source code link, a demo video, and a link to a transaction executed through KeeperHub.

name: Mini Apps Competition — Cycle II
description: Build a Mini App using the Nimiq Pay Mini Apps Framework, which handles wallets and payments so you can focus on the product. Open to developers, AI builders, vibe coders, and indie hackers, solo or in teams. Apps must be open source and can span games, productivity tools, marketplaces, or social experiences.

name: Convex All Gas Hackathon
description: Build a new full-stack app with Convex as the backend, Firecrawl for data, and AgentMail for inbox capability, using Codex or any agent with the Convex plugin. Every participant gets 20k in Firecrawl credits during the build. Judges want real apps a person would use, not developer tools.

name: Bittensor Global Subnet Hackathon
description: Design and build a new subnet for the Bittensor network, from mechanism design to a working testnet implementation. Define what work miners perform, how validators score it, and how the incentive system rewards contribution. Submit progressively: a subnet proposal by Sep 20, then a full testnet implementation, GitHub repo, demo video, and final pitch by Oct 19. Strong projects may get incubation support through Bitstarter or interviews with Bittensor accelerators.

name: OSI Hackathon
description: Formerly the LLM Hackathon for Materials Science and Chemistry, now expanded to the physical sciences and mathematics. Build LLMs, autonomous agents, datasets, benchmarks, models, or scientific software against real research problems, in teams of 3 to 10, with mentors from academia and industry. No cash prize, judged on impact potential, innovation, scalability, and domain relevance.
prize_note: None — community recognition, published paper co-authorship

name: Rare Disease Hackathon: MVA 2026
description: Real genomic and clinical data from a child living with Mosaic Variegated Aneuploidy, an ultra-rare genetic condition, shared by the family to find answers. Track 1: predict the causal genetic variant from FASTQ and VCF data, scored automatically on a live leaderboard. Track 2: propose a repurposed existing medication based on the disrupted biological mechanism, judged by an expert panel. Data access is controlled and requires an approved request; all outputs are released under CC BY 4.0.

name: Arbitrum Open House Dubai: Online Buildathon
description: Build with Arbitrum, the Layer 2 ecosystem, across DeFi, gaming, social, tools, or anything new. Use Stylus or Solidity, deploy on Arbitrum One or your own Orbit chain, and bring an existing product or start fresh. Top projects get exposure to the Arbitrum ecosystem and connect with regional leaders in Dubai. Starts Oct 31.
